article.headline: Darling scores 30, Idaho State knocks off Weber State 72-67
article.description: — Dylan Darling scored 30 points as Idaho State beat Weber State 72-67 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Darling scores 30, Idaho State knocks off Weber State 72-67

categories.description: Idaho State Bengals @ Weber State Wildcats

event.description: Idaho State Bengals @ Weber State Wildcats

keywords: Idaho State Bengals @ Weber State Wildcats
article.story: OGDEN, Utah -- — Dylan Darling scored 30 points as Idaho State beat Weber State 72-67 on Saturday night. Darling also had four steals for the Bengals (11-11, 6-5 Big Sky Conference). Jake O'Neil added 14 points while finishing 6 of 10 from the floor while he also had seven rebounds. Connor Hollenbeck went 3 of 6 from the field (2 for 3 from 3-point range) to finish with 10 points. Trevor Henning finished with 21 points and six rebounds for the Wildcats (9-16, 3-8). Weber State also got 20 points and five assists from Blaise Threatt. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
